risk-1.description: Only tests, scripts, CI, documentation or benchmark harnesses changed; no production or build-input change.

risk-2.description: Only prover or other non-verifier production code changed, with no protocol change or verifier-reaching dependency change.

risk-3.description: A small, scoped dependency or shared-code change may reach the verifier, but is directly reviewable and changes no protocol, verifier logic or commitment parameters. Broad or uncertain changes are risk-4.

risk-4.description: Protocol changes, sumcheck order or symbolic relations, transcript or Fiat-Shamir changes, verifier logic, PCS or commitment parameters, or any unclassified or uncertain change. Requires a current-head maintainer approval.
